statement: The exact set of governance-suite test identities that already fail at this baseline HEAD, so a future Gate can compare FAILURE IDENTITIES rather than failure counts. Every identity here is PREEXISTING_UNRELATED to any future Gate: none of them is produced by, or blocks, the load-bearing governance machinery, which is proven separately by the load-bearing validator set below. A future Gate introduces a regression only when a failing identity is absent from this list.
staleExpectationPolicy: An identity classified POST_GATE14_CLOSURE_STALE_EXPECTATION encodes a world that the canonical ledger has lawfully left behind. It must NOT be kept failing on purpose, and it must NOT be repaired inside an unrelated Gate. It is repaired only by a bounded, separately authorized cohort.

rootCauseClasses.GATE13_HISTORICAL_SEAL_REJECTED_BY_H3_HA: governance/gates/GATE13/state/revisions/R0002/STATE_SEAL.json binds governance/gates/GATE13/contracts/EXECUTION_CONTRACT_R0001.json where REQ-SEA-03 (introduced by the H3 seal-hardening program) requires the gate-local CURRENT_CONTRACT projection. GATE13 therefore resolves sealValid=false, the R2 context compiler fails closed on it, and every GEE R2/R4/R5/R6/R7 demonstration that is pinned to GATE13 cascades. GATE13 remains COMPLETE_CONFIRMED under the ledger and its closure is not in question.
rootCauseClasses.GATE13_HISTORICAL_ARTIFACT_DRIFT: GATE13-era artifacts pin authorities that have since been lawfully amended — chiefly strategicRegistryReference.registrySha256 = 706397af (the registry as of d5b5cee6) against the live registry aaa9efcd. validate-active-gate.mjs already contains the canonical containment for this: a CLOSED gate is a historical record and is not re-authorized against a mutable registry. The tests predate that containment.
rootCauseClasses.POST_GATE14_CLOSURE_STALE_EXPECTATION: Tests written while GATE14 was IN_PROGRESS at state revision R0003 and ledger length 57/58 hardcode that world. GATE14 closed at R0005 with ledger events 60 and 61. The assertions, not the repository, are what is out of date.

loadBearingMachineryStatus.statement: Recomputed at this baseline. These are the checks a Gate lifecycle actually depends on; all pass, which is why the 70 identities above are classified unrelated.
